plotSections.title: Exhaustion and Hanzuni’s scrutiny
bullets: Walker asks Hanzuni for something to remedy terrible daily exhaustion despite constant training.
Hanzuni perceives shimmering magical energy on Walker and mocks his mismatched star sapphire and star ruby earrings.
He offers an even-value hoard trade for matching gems; Walker refuses to keep the story of gems won from a past dragon hoard fight.
Hanzuni says many hoard items could cure exhaustion, but removing magical items requires a Sunder Chase.

plotSections.title: The plated gold hand
bullets: Walker cannot remove his golden hand to throw into the hoard.
Hanzuni grabs it and slides off a perfect golden replica, revealing Walker’s normal flesh hand beneath.
It is not a gauntlet but plated gold; Hanzuni returns it and Walker can reattach it like a perfect-fitting glove.
Hanzuni estimates it weighs roughly thirty pounds, or about four hundred troy ounces of gold.
Walker is unsettled to learn it can come off; Hanzuni says many people do not realize it is only plated.

plotSections.title: Sunder Chase rules
bullets: Participants choose as many magical hoard items as they wish, then must race.
Items lost overboard during the race return to the hoard; non-winners lose all taken items back to the hoard.
Only the winner’s chosen treasures permanently leave Hanzuni’s hoard.
Walker wants to compete but lacks time; Sylan notes retrieving gold from Midgar would be faster.

plotSections.title: Hanzuni’s gold loan
bullets: Hanzuni can loan plain gold from the hoard but cannot give magical items such as a potion of vitality directly.
His interest is not monetary; he charges a quest because he cannot leave the hoard unattended.
For the price of Quaylin’s twelve-hundred-gold potion, he asks Walker to bring him an island crab, which he has not eaten in a long time.
Hanzuni tips that Quaylin favors alabaster herring, especially pickled, and may haggle down a few hundred gold.

chronologicalEvents: Walker asks Hanzuni for an exhaustion remedy.
Hanzuni detects magical shimmer on Walker and criticizes his mismatched star gem earrings.
Hanzuni offers a hoard gem trade; Walker declines.
Hanzuni explains hoard magical items require a Sunder Chase to remove.
Walker fails to remove his golden hand; Hanzuni pulls off a plated gold replica instead.
Hanzuni returns the hand; Walker learns it weighs about thirty pounds and reattaches it.
Hanzuni clarifies Sunder Chase rules for selecting and keeping hoard treasure.
Walker asks to buy a potion of vitality; Hanzuni offers a gold loan instead.
Hanzuni proposes a quest-payment loan for twelve hundred gold: bring him an island crab.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Suffers worsening daily exhaustion despite training and use of magical rites Hanzuni can perceive.
Wears mismatched star sapphire and star ruby earrings from a past dragon hoard fight.
His golden hand is plated gold, not a gauntlet, and can be removed as a solid replica weighing about thirty pounds.
Declines Hanzuni’s gem trade and a Sunder Chase due to time pressure.
Seeks a potion of vitality and accepts Hanzuni’s quest-based gold loan terms.

Hanzuni.existing: Ancient copper dragon whose hoard sits at the center of Haven Hold.
notes: Perceives shimmering magical energy on Walker and criticizes his earring mismatch.
Can remove Walker’s plated gold hand and identifies it as pure gold plating.
Estimates the detached gold hand at roughly thirty pounds or four hundred troy ounces.
Cannot give magical hoard items without a Sunder Chase; can loan plain gold from the hoard.
Charges no monetary interest—repayment is a quest because he cannot leave the hoard.
Offers twelve hundred gold in exchange for an island crab.
Knows Quaylin may haggle if offered pickled alabaster herring.
personality: Fashion-conscious, bored without recent races, and pragmatic about hoard rules.
quotesThemes: What I charge is the quest.

Quaylin.existing: Duck Aarakocra shopkeeper of Quaylin’s Quax in Sunder.
notes: Charges twelve hundred gold for a potion of vitality.
Is partial to alabaster herring, especially pickled, and may reduce price by a few hundred gold.
Contestants choose any number of magical hoard items before racing.
Items lost overboard during the race return to the hoard.
If the racer is not the winner, all taken items return to the hoard.
Only the winner permanently keeps chosen hoard treasures.

Haven Hold.existing: Sunder district containing Hanzuni’s dragon hoard.
notes: Plain gold can pass out of the hoard by loan, but magical items cannot leave without a Sunder Chase win.

Midgar.existing: Midgar realm and Arch of Atlas.
notes: Sylan suggests Walker could teleport there to retrieve his stored gold faster than running a Sunder Chase alone.
